notes.title: Final Release for Tome of Fates - Free to play !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

After careful consideration of what’s best for the game and its future, I’ve decided to release Tome of Fates as a [b]free-to-play[/b]!

This transition will happen on [b]Friday, February 21, 2025[/b].

Until then, the game remains available for purchase, and once Steam updates the listing, it will officially be free for everyone to enjoy.

[b]What’s Next?[/b]
I’ll be actively supporting the game, answering questions, and helping with any technical issues—both here on the Steam forums and in our Discord community.

Thank you for being part of this journey!

See you in your creation !
Pleasure as always,
Kamz

notes.title: Monthly update
notes.notes:
Update 36
    Patch 1.0.21

This will likely be the final update before the full release!

I’m very happy with the current state of the game. While there’s always room for more features and improvements, I believe this is a strong foundation to build upon.

As a sneak peek of what’s coming next, I’ve added Chapter 1 of the upcoming story, which I’ll be focusing on over the next few months to prepare for its release.

One of my key priorities has always been ensuring backward compatibility. This means that all the stories created by players will remain fully functional in future versions of the game.

Thank you for your support, and I can’t wait to hear your thoughts as we approach release day!

notes.title: Bi-weekly update
notes.notes:
Weekly Update 19
    Patch 1.0.4

Hey,
Quick update on where the game is going.
I am switching gears and will start focusing on what I do best, programming.
There are lots of features that I want to implement in the game, but haven't had the time yet due to splitting my focus into many areas.
I have onboarded 2 writers to help write new (and much better) stories, and I am very excited to soon show the work they are putting together.
I am also working with a UI/UX artist to help transition some of the game interfaces that were poorly (ATROCIOUSLY) conceived by me.

There is the new story released with this patch, I would love to hear how you feel about it, if there is any issue, if it's too hard or anything else you'd like to add!

If you have any feedback or ideas, I would love to hear them either on the Steam discussion page or in our discord!

notes.title: Released on Steam Early Access !
notes.notes:

Early Access 1.0.0

The game is officially released on Steam Early Access !

Thanks once again to everyone involved, more QoL is coming to the editor, and i am excited to see all the community feedback on where to take the game.

Moving forward, the game updates will be maintained in both Windows and Linux versions, at a rate of twice per month, based on community feedback and what I feel the game would benefit from.
